# Campfire: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-21 · code c6053541e11b · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** A campfire simulated live: fluid-simulated flames, crackles made by chance, logs that char and fall in. Three campsites, a sleep timer, no sign-up.
**Live:** https://campfire.anvil.app/ · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/campfire · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/campfire/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py campfire` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **The fire is an engine in `theme/assets/cf-*.js`**, not in the Forms. Where things live: flames = `cf-fire.js`
  (GPU simulation on bare WebGL 2 + the slice shader that draws it); the wood, the frame loop, tiers, the quality
  governor, weather = `cf-engine.js`; places, sky, wind sway, trees = `cf-world.js`; sparks, smoke, mist, moths,
  snow, post-processing = `cf-fx.js`; every sound = `cf-audio.js`; the people in your circle = `cf-people.js`.
- **Look and measure before changing the engine:** `tools/dev/README.md` (standalone harness; `look.py shots OUT
  --gpu` draws on the PC's graphics card through headless Chrome, a screenshot in seconds).
- Picture quality: Settings sends auto / high / medium / low / lite to `engine.setQuality`. On auto the engine
  guesses a tier (`CF.guessTier`), a governor adjusts resolution and remembers it in localStorage `campfire.perf`.
  Tests (`?cftest=1`) pin the `low` tier and switch the governor and the 30-frame rest off.
- The sleep timer ends with the engine asleep (nothing drawn, sound suspended); any touch or key wakes it
  (`engine.wake`, events `slept` / `woke` to Pages/Fire).
- `theme/assets/place-*.jpg` are renders of the engine (About page, place picker): remake them when the look changes.
- **The circle's text** (2026-11-18): names and three-word messages are filtered on the server in
  `server_code/Profanity.py` (never trust the browser); messages are news of kind "say" (column `text`) and rise out
  of the flames in `cf-people.js` People.say (DOM over the canvas, placed every drawn frame). Gestures: Presence
  GESTURES + cf-people.js DUR/NOTES/pose branch + Dialogs/Circle. "Nothing plays twice" is enforced in four places
  (server `_post` aid + 3 s repeat, Pages/Fire `_VISIT` + AGAIN_MS + held keys, Person.play): keep all four.
- **2026-11-20:** invitations (`#fire/<circle id>`: Presence.circle_invite + ember_heartbeat `circle=` + `_join(prefer=)`,
  Pages/Fire invite_id/_show_invite/invite_link, Dialogs/Circle invite button), Let it go (Dialogs/LetGo -> FireStage
  .burn_paper -> cf-engine.js burnPaper + cf-audio.js paper + app.css .cf-paper; nothing sent), tonight's question
  (client_code/questions.py, Dialogs/Circle question_label, Pages/Fire _ask_soon), screen wake lock (Pages/Fire
  _sync_awake, Settings `awake`).
<!-- /NOTES -->

- **circle_news**: circle:str, nid:str, seat:num, kind:str, to_seat:num, wood:str, wet:bool, at:dt, text:str · used in Presence

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/session_test.py`: Expired-session test: the app must reload quietly (same page, still signed in, typed text kept) ins…
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
